activity_b.text: Good morning, everyone.
Thank you for coming today.
My name is Mr. Fernando, and I am the Principal of SLGTI, so for many of you in Year One, this is our first official meeting.
Today, I would like to talk about what the school is doing at the moment and what we are planning for the near future.
First of all, there is a maintenance team working near the main entrance because the floor is uneven and unsafe.
We are fixing it this week because students are using that entrance every day.
There are also electricians checking the wiring in the workshops.
They are replacing old cables because safety is our main priority.
At the same time, SLGTI is preparing for next term.
There is a new timetable on the notice board, and the office staff are updating student records.
They are doing this now so that theory classes can start on time next month.
A few new instructors are joining the school this term, and they are attending orientation sessions this week.
We are also upgrading our learning facilities.
There is a new computer lab under preparation, where the technicians are installing new software.
We are setting it up because digital skills are extremely important for all students.
In addition, there are new tools arriving for AT and MT workshops this afternoon.
The storekeepers are going to check and label them so that everything is ready for the practical sessions starting on Monday.
We are planning to organize several activities this week.
There is a career guidance programme for final-year students starting this Tuesday, and some guest speakers from various local companies are going to visit the school at the end of the month.
We are arranging these sessions because students need to prepare for new job markets.
Please take time to study the details of all these valuable programmes on the notice board.
Also feel free to talk to your class instructor if you have any further questions.
I think that’s all for now.
Thank you for your attention, and please cooperate with the ongoing activities.
